tags.TITLE: Lazy
tags.LYRICS:
[Verse 1]
Alarm goes off, I've pressed snooze ten times already
Five more minutes turn to thirty, so I get up and crawl to the kitchen
Dishes are piled high, I don't wanna do 'em
I turn a blind eye and go back to the bedroom
As I leave, I notice clothes in the machine
Been there since last week
They're probably not clean anymore, they're gonna reek
Fuck it, I'll just chuck them on another spin

[Pre-Chorus]
But what for? I'll only do this again
But what for? I'll only do this again
But what for? I'll only do this again
But what for?

[Verse 2]
I'll turn my knickers inside out one more time
And cut the bottom off my toothpaste
It's not just that I can't be arsed to go to the shop
Yeah, I'm lazy, but nobody likes waste
I'll add it to the never-ending list of shit to do
That I'm not gonna do, let's be honest
Procrastination's my middle name
And doing jack shit is my favourite game


[Pre-Chorus]
But what for? I'll only do this again
But what for? I'll only do this again
But what for? I'll only do this again
But what for? I'll only do this again

[Chorus]
'Cause I'm lazy and I like it
I'm lazy and I like it
I'm lazy and I like it
I wake up just to go back to sleep
'Cause I'm lazy and I like it
I'm lazy and I like it
I'm lazy and I like it
I stand up just to sit back down

[Verse 3]
I'm king of my castle
I'm the captain of this ship
If it sinks, I'll go down with it
And if it stinks, I'll spray Febreze on it
Sit on my trash throne 'cause I'm gross
I'm a slob, I don't deserve a job
All I wanna do is stare at the ceiling
Lying down is what I'm feeling


[Bridge]
Don't wanna do my dishes, don't wanna tidy up
Don't wanna pay my bills, don't wanna go to work
Don't wanna do my shopping, don't wanna sweep my floor
Don't wanna make my bed, don't wanna do my chores
You can't make me
You can't make me
You can't make me
You can't make me

[Chorus]
'Cause I'm lazy and I like it
I'm lazy and I like it
I'm lazy and I like it
I wake up just to go back to sleep
'Cause I'm lazy and I like it
I'm lazy and I like it
I'm lazy and I like it
I stand up just to sit back down

[Outro]
'Cause I'm lazy and I like it
I'm lazy and I like it
I'm lazy and I like it
I get up just to sit back down
